items.label: core
items.meaning: 文章称华尔街分析师预计，NVIDIA今年剩余时间的收入增长为82%，2027年为41%。这是预测，不是已报告业绩。
items.quote: That sounds like further revenue growth ahead, and that's exactly what Wall Street analysts are projecting as well. For the rest of this year, they expect 82% growth. For 2027, that figure rises to 41%.
items.why: 收入增长预期直接关系公司估值及FY2027收入判断。原文未解释比较基准或是否采用财年口径，且将低于82%的41%称为上升，不能直接据此计算FY2027收入。

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 文章称分析师对截至2028年1月的FY2028平均每股收益预测为12.76美元。
items.quote: For fiscal 2028, ending January 2028, the average analyst projects $12.76 in earnings per share.
items.why: 远期每股收益预期有助于理解估值，但它不是FY2027业绩，也不能直接等同于公司利润。

items.label: core
items.meaning: 据文章转述，SK hynix预计2027年将是内存短缺最严重的一年，紧张局面持续至2030年。
items.quote: SK hynix, one of the big three memory chip manufacturers, even says that 2027 is set to be the “worst year” for the memory shortage and said that the crunch will last until 2030.
items.why: 主要存储供应商的多年短缺展望可能影响NVIDIA产品成本和上市，尤其是文中报道的RTX 50 Super内存瓶颈。这是预测，并非对特定GDDR7供货或价格的保证。

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 美银转述AMD的估计：在模拟的100千瓦部署中，EPYC 9965的机架吞吐量约为Vera基准的2.4倍，下一代EPYC 6预计约为3.3倍。
items.quote: BofA notes that AMD estimates its EPYC 9965 (Turin) chip delivers approximately 2.4x the rack-level throughput of NVIDIA's Vera baseline in a modeled 100kW deployment, with the next-generation EPYC 6 (Venice) projected to extend that advantage to roughly 3.3x total throughput, according to BofA's characterization of AMD's own estimates.
items.why: 这有助于评估Vera面临的服务器CPU竞争，但数字来自AMD自身模型，不能视为独立实测或客户采用结果；机架吞吐量也不能概括Vera强调的延迟和系统整合价值。

items.label: exclude
items.meaning: 警方称，四家公司预计于7月6日合共面临八项虚假陈述欺诈指控；涉案服务器可能含有NVIDIA先进AI芯片。
items.quote: The four companies will also face a total of eight charges of fraud by false representation which are due to be announced on July 6, which the SPF said was “the first instance of corporate entities being prosecuted in relation to these investigations.”
items.why: 具体企业指控并未确认服务器所含芯片或最终目的地，也未涉及对NVIDIA的直接指控；不足以改变H200中国审批或公司财务判断。

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 7月24日，NVIDIA与微软、Meta等公司联署公开信，敦促政策制定者避免对开放权重AI模型实施“过早限制”。
items.quote: Nvidia , Microsoft , Meta , Palantir and more than 20 other companies released a letter Friday urging policymakers to avoid "premature restrictions" on open-weight artificial intelligence models that would "stifle competition or drive innovation overseas."
items.why: 这显示NVIDIA对开放AI生态及潜在限制的政策立场，对长期计算需求有参考价值；但联署不是正式政策决定，也不能证明美国将采纳其主张。

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 美国财长贝森特周二对CNBC表示，特朗普政府将调查中国企业是否窃取美国知识产权，并称政府有能力因此实施制裁。
items.quote: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC on Tuesday that the Trump administration would look into whether Chinese companies were stealing American intellectual property, and stated that the government has "the ability to sanction them because of this theft."
items.why: 高级官员的表态反映中国AI企业面临的政策风险，但并未宣布制裁，也没有具体针对NVIDIA芯片或H200销售作出决定。

items.label: exclude
items.meaning: 白宫顾问Michael Kratsios周三称，中国Moonshot AI通过蒸馏Anthropic技术开发了Kimi K3模型。
items.quote: White House advisor Michael Kratsios on Wednesday said that China's Moonshot AI developed its Kimi K3 model by distilling Anthropic's technology.
items.why: 这是关于特定模型技术来源的指称，未明确涉及NVIDIA芯片或正式限制；不能仅据此推断发生了盗窃或改变公司财务预测。

items.label: core
items.meaning: 文章称管理层在最近一次季度电话会上预测，超大规模云厂商支出2026年将达6500亿美元，2027年将超过1万亿美元。
items.quote: During its last quarterly conference call, management forecast that it expects hyperscaler spending to top $1 trillion in 2027 after reaching a projected $650 billion in 2026 .
items.why: 支出展望直接关系AI基础设施需求及NVIDIA收入判断，也与2026、2027年资本开支问题相关。原文未明确统计是否仅限四大厂商、是否全部属于数据中心资本开支，不能直接当作问题答案。
